---
title: Section references
author: Test Author
lang: fr
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: In French, a reference to an unnumbered section takes the French supplement that Quarto gives.
        check: bash _checks/xref.sh section 'Section Introduction'
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrors: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['See #ref\(<sec-intro>, supplement: \[']
---
